frozenBudget.interpretation: Inherit discrete-class numerical budgets only; all captures retain their actual NVIDIA/Windows identity. Historical macOS evidence is not a Windows baseline.

order: Alternate browser and workload order each cohort; alternate reference/candidate order. Every registered capture is retained.
measurement: Frozen room, instance and Forward fixtures; separate CPU runtime and GPU timestamps; equal per-frame completion/readback on both sides. These offscreen frame-wall measurements are not presented FPS.
hostEvidence: Read-only Windows CPU/GPU/driver/power identity before and after the matrix; CPU busy samples before and after each capture. No claim of uninterrupted frequency stability; all cohort spread checks retained.
release: Full coverage, raw artifact audit, frozen budgets and three-cohort stability required; local dirty results cannot grant clean-candidate release qualification.
